results.title: Sweden's World Cup Team: Expected Starting Lineup, Squad, and Clubs | Sweden Herald
highlights:
### Expected Swedish Starting Lineup in the World Cup
[...]
The most likely Swedish starting lineup appears to be a 4-4-2 or a flexible 4-2-3-1/4-4-2 where Isak and Gyökeres play together. Potter has hinted that he sees Isak in an offensive role, likely alongside Gyökeres. However, this duo has a lot to prove, and in the final friendly against Greece, the collaboration between the stars didn't work out as well.
[...]
#### Expected Starting Lineup:
[...]
- Goalkeeper: Viktor Johansson
- Defenders: Emil Holm, Isak Hien, Victor Nilsson Lindelöf, Daniel Svensson
- Midfielders: Anthony Elanga, Lucas Bergvall, Mattias Svanberg, Yasin Ayari
- Forwards: Alexander Isak, Viktor Gyökeres
[...]
There are many question marks as the Swedish national team hasn't had time to gel. Will Elanga (Newcastle) start as a winger, joker, or pure striker? Will Bergvall (Spurs) get immediate trust in a World Cup? And who will be the first-choice goalkeeper? Both friendly matches against Norway and Greece, which served as dress rehearsals for the World Cup, left many questions unanswered. A joker who definitely got the crowd going and impressed with his dribbling was Malmö FF player Taha Ali. Even Isak expressed great admiration for Ali after the match against Greece, which ended 2-2.
[...]
